name: DICLOFENAC 75 MG / VITAMINS B12 5 MG / B6 100 MG / B1 100 MG INJECTABLE SOLUTION 6 AMPOULES
description: Diclofenac is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain, inflammation, and swelling. It is commonly used to treat conditions such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and menstrual pain. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
